thesis: Miami International Holdings (MIAX) owns and operates U.S. SEC-regulated securities exchanges and related market infrastructure. **[Fact]** The **MIAX Exchanges** include MIAX Options, MIAX Pearl (options and equities), MIAX Emerald, and MIAX Sapphire. **[Fact]** The group also operates the **Bermuda Stock Exchange**, **MIAX Futures Exchange**, and proprietary matching technology. **[Fact]** Revenue is primarily **transaction and clearing fees**, **access fees**, and **market data** (Q1 2026 fee mix: ~$315M transaction/clearing, ~$33M access, ~$13M market data, ~$8M other, in thousands per `10-Q_20260508`). **[Fact]** FY2025 consolidated revenue was **$1.364 billion** (+19.6% versus $1.140 billion in FY2024); net income **$70 million** (versus **$102 million** in FY2024 when debt-extinguishment and intangible-sale gains boosted earnings). **[Fact]** Cash and equivalents **$434 million** at 12/31/2025; about **69.8 million** diluted shares (FY2025 10-K).
why_market_wrong: **[Inference]** The stock listed recently and trades near **~19 times** normalized free cash flow per share at **~$40**, so the market may be capitalizing fast revenue growth and futures/options share gains ahead of proven margin expansion. **[Inference]** FY2025 reported net income fell year over year even as revenue rose, because FY2024 included large non-operating gains (debt extinguishment and intangible dispositions per 10-K XBRL), which can make the franchise look weaker than mid-cycle owner cash. **[Inference]** No approved third-party work is in the file yet; return at this price is mostly **operating toll growth at a full multiple**, not a dated mispricing catalyst.
